This is a planning shell, not a released student assignment. The teacher still needs to add the actual classroom computer photograph, exterior PSU nameplate photograph, approved measurement method, and final values.

::: {.callout-important title="Safety boundary"}
Students must not open the PSU or probe energized internal circuits. Any future power reading must use a teacher-approved external wall power meter or verified documentation.
:::

## Planned lab sequence

1. Record the actual computer make, model, asset number, and exterior PSU rating.
2. Add photographs of the actual computer and the exterior PSU label.
3. Explain parallel loads, the power button as a control input, the sealed PSU boundary, and rated versus present power.
4. Complete the six-question GUESS sequence using teacher-approved values and sources.
5. Complete the final safety check and submission instructions after the lab procedure is approved.

## Fillable Google Doc

[Open the Computer Power and Parts Lab Shell](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abKEp-Oru2ujEJCsbh2ldqBW_6vl1f-TKLhgq9PP2Vg/edit)

## Before release

- Select the actual classroom computer.
- Add both photographs.
- Approve the measurement method.
- Cite every supplied value.
- Check the calculations and significant figures.
- Replace this draft notice with the final Classroom posting.
